checks.name: Synthetic records cover business, personal and the existing purchaser form; submitted versions are preserved after edits
Category/form/office/status filters combine before server pagination; counts, page two and mismatched filters are correct
Restricted reviewers can identify their archived forms while cross-office records, unrelated archived forms, draft columns and anonymous reads stay blocked
Office buttons apply immediately with the selected category, preserve pending manual changes, reset pagination and recover from failed refreshes
Specific form, status and reference changes still wait for Apply filters on Submissions
Category buttons apply without submission, combine with offices, clear stale form selections, preserve pending manual edits and recover from failed refreshes
Clients and Appointments retain their office dropdowns and manual Apply filters behavior
Managed completed forms retain original title/order/labels, contact details, choice labels, zero, No and blank fields; all values are read-only and markup is escaped
Existing purchaser completed forms retain every saved question label and value independently of answer-object order
Owners and permitted staff see read-only original answers with unique labels; answer correction is blocked
Submission filters and read-only completed forms fit laptop, large monitor, tablet and phone widths
